C0689.title: Rong County Police Dismantle 'Antique Auction' Pyramid Scheme in Sichuan
C0689.summary: In October 2023, a woman reported to Rong County Public Security Bureau that she had been drawn into a scheme operating under the guise of 'antique auctions.'
